title: Agent Agenda: Your Daily Digest of AI Agent Breakthroughs in 5 Key Areas
angle: From self-feedback LLM agents reducing costs to multi-agent systems optimizing code and AI trading prediction markets, this roundup distills the latest advancements in autonomous AI, highlighting what's next for intelligent agents.
rationale: Stories 5, 14, and 15 represent distinct but related advancements in AI agents, making a roundup the best way to cover them efficiently.
